decisions.reason: Extending badge-award accuracy to email notifications does not change the approved badge catalog, icons, count, or dashboard layout.
The incorrect badge notification and missing confirmation email do not revise any client-approved FAQ copy.
Badge-notification accuracy does not alter Small Block ticket counters or dashboard ticket accounting.
The source does not change which metadata fields are visible or how NFT metadata and book access are represented.
A missing confirmation email is an execution symptom and does not change the referral code's identity, lifetime, sharing methods, or intended display surfaces.
Badge and email problems do not alter the Small Block prize amount, trigger, eligibility window, funding, or ticket reset rules.
The source does not modify the VRF provider, eligible draw, ticket weighting, or winner-selection method.
The badge-notification and email-registration observations do not change the required blockchain or deployment network.
The source does not change the mint price, founder share, referral commission, or prize-pool allocation.
Receiving notifications for unearned badges does not change how earned badges or other NFT state transfer on resale.
The second-purchase badge notification does not establish a change to no-referral commission recipients or allocation conditions.
The source concerns badge notifications and a purchase confirmation email, not prize delivery mode or winner-notification behavior.
